summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K disclosing the monthly conversion and redemption mechanics of its Series D Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock and the resulting adjustment to the conversion price of its 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031. For May 2026, 13,745 Series D shares were redeemed at ~$40.99 per share (including accrued dividends), settled via 301,743 common shares. The common stock volume-weighted average price was ~$1.87, leading to a note conversion price adjustment to ~$1.03 (24.34 common shares per $25 principal). This is a routine periodic capital-structure maintenance event, not a transformative special situation. Watch for continued monthly redemption cycles and potential dilution.
